default.description: What the island window may call: events, every feature, settings (read, and write for plugins that remember choices), the third-party plugins to load, their secrets, signing them in to online accounts, the corner toast window, and asking the AI model the user picked for plugins.

overlay.description: The capture overlay: read the capture, copy or save the annotated image, hide itself.

popup.description: The shortcut popup: read settings and clipboard history, copy, paste, hide itself.

settings.description: The settings window: read and write settings, list the screens the pill can sit on, toggle launch at login, try shortcuts, list or open the third-party plugins folder, browse and install from the community store, save plugins' secrets (without reading them back), test AI providers (list their models), install or remove the local PersonaPlex server, and check for and install updates.

toasts.description: The corner toast window: hear what to show, tell the island what the user did, size and place itself.
